'''Seeker Missile Racks''' fire guided missiles that lock onto a target before launch and then actively track it, unlike the straight-line missiles fired by an ordinary [[Missile Rack]].

== Overview ==

Because Seeker Missiles actively home in on their target, they are more forgiving to aim than dumbfire weapons, but the lock-on process takes time and the missiles themselves can be defeated by an enemy [[Point Defence]] turret or a well-timed [[Electronic Countermeasure]]. Like other missile weapons, ammunition is limited rather than capacitor-drawn, so magazine capacity and reload discipline matter more than heat management.
